title: Measuring Before and After Optimization — practice
prompt: A service is experiencing growth and must meet reliability goals. You are working on “Measuring Before and After Optimization”. Which practice is the strongest next step?
objective: Apply measuring before and after optimization in a controlled MySQL workflow.

options: Skip testing, assume every SQL engine behaves identically, and apply the change directly to production.
Concatenate untrusted input into SQL text and grant administrator privileges to every application user.
Judge success only by whether the statement returns any rows, without checking expected behavior or edge cases.
Capture an execution plan, record the starting query and result, change one index or query decision, and compare measurements.

expected_output: Capture an execution plan, record the starting query and result, change one index or query decision, and compare measurements.
acceptance_criteria: Select an approach that addresses the stated topic rather than bypassing checks.
Include the expected behavior and one verification step in your reasoning.
Respect the disposable-lab and selected-version assumptions.
hints: Start with the smallest repeatable example or inspection step.
Think about the expected result, then test one boundary or failure case.
Do not rely on production access, embedded secrets, or undocumented cross-version assumptions.

grading_config.correct_answer: Capture an execution plan, record the starting query and result, change one index or query decision, and compare measurements.

retry_policy.feedback: Review the related lesson, use the hints, and try again. Incorrect attempts do not award XP.
